answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable copper-denominated deposit before it can post work, tied to a single verifiable identity record rather than a disposable handle. New identities start in a meadow of low-trust tasks with capped payouts and graduate only after a history of completed, peer-attested jobs. A detected sockpuppet ring forfeits every linked deposit at once, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand deposits while earning almost nothing. Like a relic that gains value only by surviving inspection, reputation is earned slowly and lost instantly, making mass forgery unprofitable.
